items.title: Benny Golson — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History

ctx.x: S-t-r-o-t-e. Strote. Joel Strote. He handles anything. The telephone rings, that the people use. He’s on it. He handles Chick Corea too. He’s the man. He handled Liberace’s stuff, his estate in Los Vegas, up until about two years ago, I think. Because he’s got a company out here in Los Angeles. He’s the guy. Nobody mess with me now or with him.
Did Quincy Jones at any time own any of your publishing?
